description: Choose one creature adjacent to the initial target and within reach. This amount isn't doubled, and no bonuses or other additional dice apply to this damage.

description: If the target of the critical hit is adjacent to a surface, it gets stuck to that surface by the missile. The target is [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24) and must spend an Interact action to attempt a DC 10 [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check to pull the missile free; it can't move from its space until it succeeds. The creature doesn't become stuck if it is incorporeal, is liquid (like a [water elemental](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=45) or some [oozes](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=79)), or could otherwise escape without effort.
